title: 5B Conservational Change — Идиомы: природа и экология

items.example: Extinct species are just the tip of the iceberg of habitat loss.
One reserve is a drop in the ocean without global action.

items.idiom: a canary in a coal mine
items.example: Dying bees are a canary in a coal mine for the whole ecosystem.
Poaching is the elephant in the room at the tourism forum.
Predators take the lion's share of the blame, though humans cause more harm.
Grazing animals straying onto farms are fish out of water.
Conservationists swim against the tide of quick profit.
Some species cannot weather the storm of climate change.
The report on plastic waste made waves worldwide.
Some habitats recover if we let sleeping dogs lie.

items.idiom: kill two birds with one stone
items.example: Eco-tourism kills two birds with one stone: jobs and protection.
More firms go green every year.
Flying less shrinks your carbon footprint.
Scientists leave no stone unturned to save the species.
